servinfo.title: A/F Sensor Description (Gasoline Particulate Filter (GPF) Model)
servinfo.ptxt: The A/F sensor is located at the cluster of the exhaust manifold (in front of the three-way catalytic converter with GPF) and contains a sensor heater and sensor element.

item.ptxt: The sensor element is of a laminated structure which consists of a zirconia element, a detection chamber and an oxygen reference chamber. ECM detects the oxygen concentration (A/F ratio) of the exhaust emission from “LEAN” to “RICH” in proportion using the zirconia characteristic.
The sensor heater maintains the sensor element temperature at approx. 780 °C (1,436 °F) constantly by the duty control signal to activate the sensor element.
